== Infobox ==

* Place type: Palace
* Region: Kingdom of the Winkies
* Status: Active

== Biography ==

The Emperor designates the seat of the Tin Woodman (Nick Chopper), who rules over the Winkies and calls himself their Emperor, having made himself an Absolute Monarch whose conduct of public or personal affairs no one interferes with. Also referred to as the Emperor's palace, it stands within the City of the Winkies, forming part of the castle and city of the Tin Woodman, and its ruler has recently been nickel-plated.

== Events ==

Fearing for his safety, the Scarecrow resolves to flee to the Emperor's domain, seeking protection from his friend the Tin Woodman. Tip and the Scarecrow's party later reach the City of the Winkies and its Emperor's palace, where they are told that the Tin Woodman was made Emperor of the Winkies after the destruction of the Wicked Witch, and that the Emperor has recently been polished and had himself nickel-plated.
